source: concert arena with a working hear myself mic

answers.ask: What kind of concert - a slick modern stadium show, a grimy rock club, or something stylized and colourful?
answers.answer: Make it a slick modern stadium concert show, with a compact arena layout.

answers.ask: Can any player get on stage and use the mic, or is there a designated performer role?
answers.answer: Any player can get on stage and use the hear-myself mic; no designated performer role is needed.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: What kind of concert - a slick modern stadium show, a grimy rock club, or something stylized and colourful? A: Make it a slick modern stadium concert show, with a compact arena layout.
- [author] goal — Q: Can any player get on stage and use the mic, or is there a designated performer role? A: Any player can get on stage and use the hear-myself mic; no designated performer role is needed.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a compact slick modern stadium concert arena organized around one raised performance stage. Spread an open audience floor in front of the stage and wrap compact stepped seating around the rear and sides, with every sightline facing the performance area. Place one prominent microphone at centre stage and provide clear public stairs or ramps from the audience floor so any player can step up and use it. Keep the arena polished and modern without adding a restricted performer-only backstage area.

## Genre
Entertainment is the sole genre, specifically a player-accessible concert venue.

## Shape and preset
Use `venue-stage`, named Stage and Audience, so the stage anchors every audience sightline. This matches the Performance Venue preset.

## Config requirements
Use `spectator-bleachers` for compact raked seating behind and beside the audience floor. Use `social-hub` for the standing crowd area facing the stage. Use `spawn-first-reveal` for an arrival view that immediately frames the stage and audience rather than backstage geometry. The centre-stage microphone and public stage access are direct scene components.

## Layout requirements
Place one `spawn-first-reveal` SpawnZone at the rear audience entrance, oriented toward the stage. Place one scene-specific TriggerZone on the centre-stage microphone so any player can activate the hear-myself mic. Do not reserve the stage or its access route for a performer role.

## Layout components
The arena contains one raised main stage, one centre microphone position, broad public stairs or ramps onto the stage, an open standing audience floor, and compact stepped bleachers around the rear and sides. A rear entrance and spawn sightline point directly toward the stage. Arena walls form the boundary, aisles keep the seating accessible, and no separate backstage suite is included.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: render the modern stage-and-audience composition first and derive the top-down view, because sightline orientation and visual presentation lead while no topology needs procedural solving.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by a compact arena in which the stage, microphone, audience floor, and seating tiers remain individually legible. The theme is a slick modern stadium concert. Use `tiered` for raked seating with no overhanging floor; no other modifier is forced.
